dispositions: Detailed discovery is labelled by installed discovery_class and grant clearance; conservative highest-class default preserves old hashes; minimal/no-grant callers cannot probe installed class membership.

Admission observations reuse owner authorization; gateway availability/capacity is not probed. Workflow-only candidates state bound_workflow_required. Enforced mode cannot report qualification not_required.

Lineage reads owned same-role receipt metadata, never artifacts or old source authority. New links refuse in-flight/uncertain work. Failed started non-replay-safe outcomes remain uncertain despite cancellation/revocation/timeout labels.

Gateway initial linkage requires retained confirmed-stop evidence. The owner records a positive snapshot with lineage; normal ledger retention cannot invalidate an admitted successor. Contrary live evidence and identity changes still fence execution/release.

Exact idempotent replay recovers same-role receipt before re-admission. Changed binding/rationale/lineage conflicts; MCP and HTTP return only the owned receipt. Administrative caller aliases are rejected; caller result reads cannot cross operator role.

Reasons stay private in resolved metadata and never enter model input, discovery, caller status or audit detail. Artifact reuse remains separately approved source_release/transfer_id with current source/class/destination checks.
Missing test-owner runtime dependency is now test-only, pinned at an immutable public commit; Python 3.12+ owner integration is explicit. CI installs the test extra.
limits: No live subscription/account qualification or provider billing/quality claims.
No live Sovite deployment or merge of the broader draft into main.
Opt-in lineage does not infer equivalence across unrelated new keys with no lineage.
Declared interactive authentication support is not verified human presence or effect authority.
Hosted installs may need an explicit permitted discovery_class to expose details; no automatic metadata downgrade.
